prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / style refinement.
Edit this architectural illustration to look more like a carefully authored human architectural drawing, less like an AI-generated decorative image. Keep the EXACT building form, roof piece silhouettes, narrow rear lifted ribbon, camera angle, crop, layout, and existing people's activities. Do not redesign or modify roof geometry.
Retain the fine architectural pen drawing character, warm ivory mosaic roof, blue waterfront setting and red cafe accents. Refine the style with restrained hand-drawn pen and lightly washed gouache/watercolor on subtly textured paper. Slightly desaturate the electric blue sky and water into a calm dusty blue. Simplify the implausibly dense repeated scratch patterns on the mountains, distant buildings, water and roof: quieter areas of flat wash, selective line detail, small natural variations, atmospheric distance and lighter skyline contrast. Mosaic should read as believable small tiles following the curved roof, with variable fine joints rather than a uniform all-over maze texture. Subtle age staining near edges, not exaggerated decay.
Reduce overly abundant repeated white flowers and identical foliage into naturally varied clusters, occasional bare branches, imperfect asymmetry and calmer negative space. Keep planting positions and trees broadly unchanged, with less ornamental clutter. People stay small and individually posed; use understated human figure sketches, believable anatomy, varied clothing and natural contact shadows. Simplify generic cafe furnishings into coherent tables/chairs with convincing perspective, retaining the red accents and umbrellas. Refine glazing with selective reflections and less showroom glow, no new interior objects. Avoid glossy CGI, artificial sharpness, hyper-dense texture, seamless repeated brush marks, saturated poster finish. Preserve the composition and roof geometry above everything else. Single landscape illustration, no typography, signature, watermark or border.
